1.web: I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
1.asv: I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.

2.web: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it, and be glad.
2.asv: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah: The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.

3.web: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.
3.asv: Oh magnify Jehovah with me, And let us exalt his name together.

4.web: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
4.asv: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.

5.web: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
5.asv: They looked unto him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be confounded.

6.web: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
6.asv: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.

7.web: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
7.asv: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, And delivereth them.

8.web: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
8.asv: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.

9.web: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
9.asv: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints; For there is no want to them that fear him.

10.web: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
10.asv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.

11.web: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
11.asv: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

12.web: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
12.asv: What man is he that desireth life, And loveth many days, that he may see good?

13.web: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
13.asv: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.

14.web: Depart from evil, and do good. seek peace, and pursue it.
14.asv: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.

15.web: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
15.asv: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous, And his ears are open unto their cry.

16.web: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
16.asv: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

17.web: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
17.asv: The righteous cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.

18.web: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
18.asv: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.

19.web: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
19.asv: Many are the afflictions of the righteous; But Jehovah delivereth him out of them all.

20.web: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.
20.asv: He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken.

21.web: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
21.asv: Evil shall slay the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.

22.web: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
22.asv: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned.
